name: Hired Gun 2: Vengeance
source:
Our assassin is now on a new mission. He is going to Japan to kill one of the worst international criminals. Will he be able to kill his target? Or will he be killed himself? Will he meet any old friends in this mission? Play the game to find out.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210101010/http://renai.us/game/hiredgun_2.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
